idea: ITE: an interview-first environment to think and specify before building with Claude Code.

areas.summary: Turn a one-line idea into a complete, coherent, tested spec folder that Claude Code builds from; success = the A/B validation clears the D-021 pass bar (R-021).
Primary: non-engineer builders; secondary: early-career developers (D-003).
v0.1 = plugin with 4 commands and a quick mode (R-024); v0.2 = Windows-first Tauri app; export, templates, team mode are later (SPEC section 4).
Idea text and user answers only (SPEC section 6).
Fixed English spec folder with INDEX, SPEC, DECISIONS, PLAN, CLAUDE, prompts, schemas, tests (rule 02).
User's own Claude Code; Node.js 18+ for scripts (assumed).
No network, no credentials, project-folder scope only (rule 08).
Plugin: Markdown commands and skill + zero-dependency Node scripts. App: Tauri 2, React, TypeScript, xterm.js, CodeMirror 6.
The interview and compile prompts P-001, P-002, P-003 run in the user's Claude Code.
Checker error codes in rule 04; command errors in specs/commands.md; interview edge cases in rule 01 section 1.5.
CLAUDE.md definition of done for Phase 1; T-030 to T-034 for Phase 2.
